text: Matines, the egg brand on the Le Mans FC shirt, has belonged to the LDC group since 2022; LDC itself is listed on Euronext Paris (Eurolist compartment A, ISIN FR001400SF56, mnemonic LOUP) with a family shareholding of more than 69% of the capital.
short: Matines has belonged to the listed Groupe LDC since 2022.
